amendment_2: SCORED, AND ONE LEG OF MINE IS WHY THE ARM WAS NOT CLEAN. The device arm this lane could not run was run by the orchestrator on the Thor against a cherry-pick of 55551aef: Blend_tests 105 captures 1,711,362 px -> 0, every one byte-exact; Point_size 21 captures 22,746 -> 20,579 with the delta exactly 1099+1040+14+14; Viewport 12 captures 1,396 -> 1,396 unmoved as the control. Recovered point spacing is 85, not 84 -- the leg that separates the model being right from being wrong in the same direction as the fix. 121 of 122 checks passed and #67 is CLOSED. THE ONE FAILING CHECK WAS MINE: expect_counts worse=0, broken by a Stencil capture. That is not the fix and it is not measurement noise either. #79, filed since, establishes that Stencil is intermittently WRONG rather than intermittently measured -- over eight runs and 128 observations the MAJORITY image of each unstable capture is golden-exact and the outliers are wrong, about 8.6% of Stencil captures per run on both binaries, each deviation one whole region going from exactly one colour to exactly one other. So a worse=0 count on any disc carrying Stencil fails on a coin, and registering one was an error in this file. THE RULE: >= 4 runs per arm on any disc carrying Stencil, and never Stencil as a must_not_move control. THAT ALSO CORRECTS MY OWN EARLIER AMENDMENT. Amendment 1 withdrew Stencil as a must_not_move and gave the reason as lost draws -- 'intermittently measured'. The withdrawal was right and the reason was wrong: the captures are produced and are WRONG, not missing. Same action, different mechanism, and the difference matters because a lost-draw model predicts absent or blank output while what actually happens is one region substituting one exact colour for another. WHAT HELD: the desktop falsifier. 236/236 byte-identical under both renderers was registered as the only leg this lane could run, and as a real test of the aarch64 scoping rather than a formality. The scoping held -- the device moved 1.7M px and the desktop moved nothing. ONE MORE THING LEARNED FROM THIS ARM, recorded because it cost the orchestrator ten inert legs: `expect` keys are RESULTS-DIRECTORY spelling with ONE slash, `Blend_tests/#spot_0_ADD`. The `Blend tests::#spot_0_ADD` form matches nothing and an arm still returns PRE-REGISTERED, because that attests binding and not measurability. Audited every prediction file in this lane: all of them already use the slash form, so none of this lane's legs were silently inert.
